summary.intent: Land a stack of PRs (#66 object-literal member rows, #67 decision-log entries, #68 member rows, #69 ranking bonus) for the monokl code-search tool, fixing issues found in review of the object-literal rows.
summary.outcome: Fixed the match-ownership bug on #66 (d9a6c28) with 693 tests passing and 97.54% coverage; a #68 fix-up agent is running and #69 has agent-reported improved benchmarks pending verification. CI on the new commit has not yet run, and Entire Gates on #67-#69 await reviewer approval.

repo: Match ownership in the TS analyzer was decided per line, but members can start or end mid-line (`} b() {`, `}, // note`), causing spurious rows, dropped holder rows, and wrong text shown.
New ownership rule: a hit goes to the innermost block whose own text on that line matches, falling back to all blocks on the line so a match is never lost.
Local checks for this repo include tests, coverage, lint, deny, machete, drift and changesets; a harness tracks benchmarks (identifier hit@3 56/59, 59/59, questions 14/18).
`export default function X` is classified as kind `other` with a 0.7 ranking weight instead of function's weight, which buries `buildFullPath` and `dispatchRequest` in ranking.
Entire Gates fails on PRs only for 'no reviewers have approved'; all open changes have zero Entire findings.

code.finding: Match-ownership logic was changed so a hit goes to the innermost block whose own line text matches, with a fallback to all blocks on the line (commit d9a6c28).

workflow: Write failing class-based tests first, confirm they fail before the fix, then apply the fix (two failed pre-fix here).
Delegate stacked-PR fix-ups to an agent that merges the base fix into the branch and pushes without force.
Agent-reported benchmark numbers should be independently verified after the base PR merges.
Replace tests that pass without the change with ones that fail without the fix.

friction: Entire Gates blocks #67, #68 and #69 purely on missing reviewer approval.
#68 and #69 are stacked on #66 and touch overlapping directories, forcing sequential merging.
CI for the latest #66 commit had not yet run at summary time.
The #69 agent hit an analyzer bug outside its scope that it could not fix.
open_items: Fix the analyzer so `export default function X` is classified as function rather than `other`, after #68 lands.
Verify #69's agent-reported benchmark numbers once #66 merges.
Raise the member-question gate in the harness after #66 merges.
Complete the #68 fix-up (merge #66 fix, add repro tests, fix stale empty-result hint and rustdocs, replace non-discriminating tests).
Merge order: #66, then #68 and #69, then #67 at any time; obtain reviewer approvals for Entire Gates.
